ops.oldText: This Agreement is governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
ops.newText: This Agreement is governed exclusively by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules, and the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction.

input.comment: [Playbook] We replaced Singapore law and Singapore courts with New York law and exclusive jurisdiction in New York County, which is our accepted governing-law position and also removes the conflict with the New York venue already agreed in Section 28.2. If New York is not workable, we can accept Delaware, California, or England and Wales (courts of London).
input.summary: Change governing law and venue from Singapore to New York, aligning 28.1 with 28.2.
